summary: Apply AI to strategy, planning, governance, and decision support through practical management workshops. Build your implementation roadmap. Enrol now.
lede: Applied AI for business management helps managers connect AI initiatives to defined decisions and business priorities. This training covers framing decision problems, checking data readiness, prioritizing use cases, and evaluating AI-supported recommendations with human oversight. Participants practice decision matrices, risk assessment, dashboard interpretation, and preparing management briefs that document evidence, assumptions, uncertainty, risks, and recommended actions.
audienceIntro: This applied AI course serves professionals who commission, evaluate, govern, or use AI-supported analysis in management and strategic planning. It is particularly relevant when you must connect technology proposals to business priorities, risk controls, and executive decisions.
audience: Operations Planning Lead using AI for resource
modules: NIST AI RMF Applied AI Foundations
PESTLE and SWOT Applied AI Analysis
Decision Matrices for Applied AI Support
Applied AI Roadmap and Executive Reporting
prerequisites: You need a laptop capable of running a modern web browser and spreadsheet software. No coding or programming is required for course completion. Advanced AI architecture, predictive modelling, and model engineering receive conceptual awareness only; use-case design, prompt evaluation, risk assessment, decision matrices, governance mapping, dashboard interpretation, and roadmap development receive operational application and hands-on practice.
topics: Generative AI at work & AI copilots
